prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage 1980s martial arts movie poster remake for THE KARATE KID, dramatic and nostalgic, like a folded theatrical one-sheet.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, aged cream paper border, worn corners, visible fold lines crossing horizontally and vertically, subtle stains, grain, scratches, and faded print texture.

Visual style: Painted 1980s Hollywood movie-poster realism with warm orange-red sunset lighting, deep blacks, high contrast, airbrushed faces, cinematic composition, slightly imperfect vintage typography and distressed ink.

Top composition: A fiery sunset over the ocean fills the upper half. Two large heroic portrait heads dominate the sky: in front is a serious teenage martial arts student with dark tousled hair, tan skin, intense eyes, wearing a white gi and a white rising-sun headband; behind him to the upper right is an older Japanese mentor with a mustache and short gray beard, solemn expression, wearing a matching white rising-sun headband and white robe with a dotted scarf detail. Add the tagline in small white serif capitals at upper left: A WARRIOR FIGHTS FOR VICTORY. A STUDENT FIGHTS FOR HONOR.

Silhouette action vignettes: Include exactly 3 dark martial-arts silhouettes on the left side against the sunset: 1) a flying kick silhouette near the upper left sky, 2) two fighters sparring at sunset near the middle left horizon, 3) a kneeling student practicing a strike against a wooden training dummy near the lower left.

Title area: Place the huge centered title THE KARATE KID across the middle-lower poster in large cream-colored vintage serif capitals, with “THE” above “KARATE KID,” slightly distressed and shadowed.

Bottom tournament scene: Show an indoor karate tournament arena below the title. Exactly 2 teenage fighters face each other on a red-and-white mat: 1) left fighter in a white gi with black belt and circular chest patch, standing in a guarded stance, 2) right fighter in a black gi with black belt and circular patch, standing in an aggressive fighting stance. Exactly 1 referee stands centered between and behind them, wearing a red shirt and dark pants. Behind them is a crowd in dark bleachers and a tournament bracket board labeled ALL VALLEY KARATE CHAMPIONSHIP with small illegible bracket names and a clear “FINALS” section.

Credits and logos: Add a dense block of tiny white movie credits at the very bottom with names, a small studio logo at bottom left, and a small PG-style rating box at bottom right. Use NEW WORLD PICTURES Presents in the credit line.

Constraints: Keep the poster text readable where specified, preserve the 1980s theatrical poster mood, use no modern elements, no photorealistic contemporary camera look, no extra characters beyond the counted figures and silhouettes, and make the final image look like an authentic aged printed movie poster.

promptZh:
目标：为 THE KARATE KID 创建一张 20 世纪 80 年代复古武术电影海报重制版，呈现出戏剧性与怀旧感，如同折叠过的影院单张海报。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 宽高比，带有做旧的奶油色纸张边框、磨损的边角，横竖交叉的折痕，以及细微的污渍、颗粒感、划痕和褪色的印刷质感。

视觉风格：80 年代好莱坞电影海报的写实手绘风格，采用温暖的红橙色日落光影、深邃的黑色、高对比度、喷绘质感的面部、电影化的构图，以及略带瑕疵的复古字体和做旧墨迹。

上方构图：上半部分为海面上的火红日落。天空上方占据着两个巨大的英雄肖像：前方是一位神情严肃的青少年武术学生，留着凌乱的深色头发，皮肤黝黑，眼神坚定，身穿白色道服，佩戴白色旭日头带；在他右上方后方是一位留着胡须、短灰胡茬的年长日本导师，表情庄重，佩戴同款白色旭日头带，身穿白色长袍，配有圆点围巾细节。左上角以白色小号衬线大写字母添加标语：A WARRIOR FIGHTS FOR VICTORY. A STUDENT FIGHTS FOR HONOR.

剪影动作小图：在左侧日落背景下包含 3 个精确的武术剪影：1) 左上方天空附近的飞踢剪影，2) 左侧中部地平线附近两名格斗者正在切磋，3) 左下方一名跪地的学生正在对着木人桩练习出拳。

标题区域：在海报中下部居中放置巨大的标题 THE KARATE KID，采用大型奶油色复古衬线大写字母，“THE”位于“KARATE KID”上方，带有轻微的做旧和阴影效果。

底部锦标赛场景：在标题下方展示一个室内空手道锦标赛场地。红白相间的垫子上站着 2 名青少年格斗者：1) 左侧格斗者身穿白色道服，系黑带，胸前有圆形补丁，摆出防御姿势；2) 右侧格斗者身穿黑色道服，系黑带，胸前有圆形补丁，摆出进攻姿势。中间后方站着 1 名裁判，身穿红色衬衫和深色长裤。他们身后是深色看台人群，以及一个标有 ALL VALLEY KARATE CHAMPIONSHIP 的锦标赛项目，上面有模糊的对阵名单和清晰的“FINALS”（决赛）区域。

演职员表与标志：在最底部添加密集的白色微型电影演职员表，左下角放置一个小型的制片厂标志，右下角放置一个 PG 级评级框。在演职员表中使用 NEW WORLD PICTURES Presents。

约束条件：在指定位置保持海报文字清晰可读，保留 80 年代影院海报的氛围，不使用任何现代元素，避免现代摄影的写实感，除指定的角色和剪影外不添加额外人物，确保最终图像看起来像一张真实且经过岁月洗礼的印刷电影海报。
